entities.summary: Peter Marzinkowski was a German Roman Catholic prelate of the Congregation of the Holy Spirit. He was appointed bishop of Alindao from 2004 to 2014. He died at Knechtsteden Abbey in Dormagen, on 21 October 2024, at the age of 85.
